scope: independent root audit of the moving-dyadic witness family and the all-depth, all-degree projective collapse of the actual beta suffix transducer

mathematical_audit.actual_implication: for an actual target, gcd(abs(a^2-kappa*b),b)=gcd(a,b)^2=1, so every divisor D of b sees a unit projective scalar and the target also forces R=epsilon*a^2 modulo D
mathematical_audit.moving_dyadic_construction: with M=2^(s-1), an interval of 2n-3 at least 2M consecutive kappa values contains two representatives of the required residue; excluding the at-most-one exact equality leaves a canonical two-top-digit witness
mathematical_audit.window_and_sign: the beta recurrence gives a=B*c+d, d>B/2+1/2 and d<c; these inequalities place R=g*c+d strictly between a/(2c) and a/2, with 0<abs(E)=kappa<c and the declared positive target sign
mathematical_audit.projective_collapse: L_j=R*H_j-b*N_j and H_m=1 imply L_j-H_j*L_m=-b*N_j at every depth; homogeneous substitution gives F(L)=R^e*F(H) modulo every D dividing b for arbitrary depth and degree
mathematical_audit.non_target_comparator: the canonical word R=1, delta_1=1 has every suffix load zero and hence L=H, while it lies below the intermediate target window; projective residue data therefore cannot distinguish the target
mathematical_audit.capacity_scope: the available moving dyadic precision has logarithmic mass at most log(2n-3)=o(n); divided quotients, modulus b^2 or higher, integer-size estimates, redigitization, and the original exact equality are not closed

PROVED: moving dyadic countermodels for every n>=6 and 2^s<=2n-3
all-depth transducer lift and arbitrary-degree homogeneous projective collapse
PROVED_SCOPED_NO_GO: logarithmically growing dyadic truncation without new odd arithmetic cannot imply the exact target
digit-independent projectively homogeneous residue tests on the complete suffix tower add no target codimension
EXACT_FINITE_ONLY: all replay witness rows, polynomial substitutions, and digests
OPEN: the original all-digit beta equality and centered half-bound
super-logarithmic or full dyadic precision coupled to odd arithmetic
divided suffix-load quotients and modulus b^2 or higher
integer-size nonlinear invariants and canonical redigitization
